item.title: rethinking notes to self
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
A quick write-up on notes to self, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Notes to self shows up across writing work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: notes to self, revisited
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I keep coming back to notes to self, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Notes to self shows up across writing work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
